newsitem.title: USA: Inamed adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Inamed adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: INAMED Corp said Tuesday its board has adopted a stockholder rights plan that would become effective if anyone acquired or tried to acquire 15 percent or more of its common stock.
The plan, designed to protect against an unfavorable or unsolicited takeover, would let rights holders buy the company's stock at a discounted price.

The company said distribution of rights will be made to stockholders of record June 13 and that newly issued common shares after June 13 will also carry rights until the rights become detached from the common shares.
The rights will expire June 2, 2007, the company said.
